_meta.note: A Workflow call (script tiny-greet: one phase Greet, agents a and b): its task_started (task_type local_workflow, workflow_name tiny-greet), three task_progress whose workflow_progress lists the workflow_phase row and the workflow_agent rows (a started, a done and b started, then both done; b's first row has no agentId yet), the turn's end between the second and the third, then the task_updated (completed), the task_notification (completed) and Claude Code's own cycle answering it. The Workflow tool result's text is shortened to the lines that carry no host path (its script and transcript paths are dropped). Every frame but the edits named here is a live frame of claude-agent-acp 0.107.0 (v1 core) over Claude Code 2.1.325, read off a scratch ACP client that sent session/new with _meta.claudeCode.emitRawSDKMessages [{type: system}] beside options (dist/v1/acp-agent.js 7857 reads it, 8109-8117 shouldEmitRawMessage matches it, 2899-2905 sends each match as the _claude/sdkMessage extension notification {sessionId, message}). Kept: the turn's tool frames, its reply, the closing usage_update and prompt result, and the _claude/sdkMessage frames of the five subtypes Crew's own filter asks for (acp.raw_sdk_tasks.RAW_SDK_MESSAGE_FILTER); the other system messages that filter would not bring (init, status, thinking_tokens, background_tasks_changed, session_state_changed, commands_changed) are left out, as are the bulk available_commands_update frames. Normalized: the session id, the SDK message uuids, the tool call ids, the message ids, each task's output_file path (to <tasks>/<task_id>.output), and the model the Workflow agents ran on (to probe-model); the usage_update frames lose their _claude/model and cost and the prompt result its _meta quota, which name the recording account's models and spend. Held as synthesized, not live, because the corpus holds every live claude capture to the Real Adapter lane's pin (test/real_adapters/package.json), which this release is not.
